feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit. And, Netanyahu gives defiant UNGA speech
entry.summary: Trump and Xi's U.S. summit continues after a state dinner Thursday night. And, Netanyahu returns to Israel after giving a defensive and defiant speech at the U.N. General Assembly.

entry.title: Former U.S. ambassador to China on Xi Jinping's visit to Washington
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with former U.S. Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns about Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to Washington and what has been accomplished.

entry.title: Netanyahu rages against critics, including Mamdani, at the U.N. General Assembly
entry.summary: Middle East crises draw major focus as the U.N. General Assembly hears from Israel, the Palestinian Authority and Yemen.

entry.title: Is Switzerland's neutrality at a crossroads?
entry.summary: Switzerland is voting on whether to tighten its famous neutrality — a move that could reshape its response to Russia and future conflicts.

entry.title: Iran's president says his country has 'no trust' in U.S. in meeting with journalists
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep was part of a small group of journalists who met with an Iranian official on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly in New York. He tells Leila Fadel what he learned.

entry.title: Former U.S. Ambassador to Israel on Netanyahu's speech at UNGA
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with former U.S. Ambassador to Israel Thomas Nides about Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's speech at the United Nations General Assembly.

entry.title: Trump's state dinner for Xi features sea bass and a long list of tech titans
entry.summary: A tech-heavy guest list, the fashion choices of those on it, who sat where and what was on the menu marked the softer — often and glitzier — details of diplomacy as Donald Trump threw a Thursday night state dinner honoring China's leader Xi Jinping.

entry.title: Thousands of people gather for a South African barbecue, aiming to set a world record
entry.summary: South Africa is aiming to smash a savory world record — the world's largest BBQ — and more boerewors sausage than you can shake a stick at.

entry.title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit amid underlying tensions
entry.summary: Despite the pageantry and the cordial tone, expectations for any big breakthroughs on issues ranging from AI to Iran to a trade war truce are low.

entry.title: Judge restores journalists' White House access. And, Tucker Carlson on his MAGA split
entry.summary: A judge has ordered that the Trump administration restore journalists' access to White House. And, Tucker Carlson sits down with Morning Edition's Steve Inskeep for a Newsmakers interview.
